column1: # clipfmt rules: what a copied link pastes as in apps that read rich text, like Slack.
# one line per pattern: type <TAB> pattern (the whole URL) <TAB> short text ($1, $2: the groups).
# the short text is URL-decoded and + becomes a space. a type can have more than one line.
#   this file reloads by itself. after editing clipfmt.swift: bash ~/dotfiles/clipfmt/clipfmt.sh rebuild
# a type works only when dott turned it on (its clipfmt-<type> group). other links stay as they are.
